title: Usage-band pricing + soft-cap automation PRD
creator: Aisha Khan
description: PRD for introducing usage-band pricing (discrete bands with escalating per-unit rates) combined with a soft-cap automation layer. Goal: reduce surprise overage charges, provide predictable cost signals to customers, and enable automated, reversible soft-cap actions (warnings, temporary burst, suggested plan upgrade) before hard cap enforcement. This ticket defines requirements, acceptance criteria, rollout phases, and billing integration points.
proposed_plan: 1) Define canonical band model and UI representation. 2) Implement soft-cap enforcement engine that emits telemetry, alert headers, and optional throttles. 3) Billing integration: create banded invoice line items, pro-rata adjustments on plan changes mid-cycle, and automated overage charge flows. 4) Console and API visibility: usage meter with forecast, X-Redwood-SoftCap response header, admin controls to toggle auto-burst/escalation. 5) Telemetry and audit logs for compliance and reconciliation.
rollout_phases: Phase 0: Data model + internal feature flag (backend only) - validation with historical usage data
Phase 1: Soft-launch for <10% of customers (non-billing) - warnings + UI meter + telemetry
Phase 2: Billing-enabled for beta customers - generate invoices with banded line items, optional opt-in
Phase 3: Full rollout - default soft-cap active, automated overage billing and upgrade prompts
Phase 4: Post-launch tuning - pricing adjustments, thresholds, and opt-out paths
acceptance_criteria: Pricing bands exist in canonical config and can be updated without code deploy (console + API).
For any customer, the usage meter in Console shows current band, next-band threshold, and predicted end-of-cycle cost with >=80% accuracy for last-30-day consumption patterns.

When usage crosses soft-cap, the system emits a telemetry event, sets a warning header (X-Redwood-SoftCap: true) on subsequent responses, and surfaces a Console banner within 60s of crossing the threshold.

Soft-cap actions are configurable per-account: (none, warn-only, throttle-to-rate, temporary-burst-with-auto-fallback, prompt-upgrade). Configuration can be set via Console and the Account Settings API.
Hard-cap must not be enforced while soft-cap mode is active unless explicitly escalated; hard-cap enforcement still produces 429 with standard retry-after semantics and is documented.

Billing: overage charges are calculated per-band and appear as separate invoice line items with clear breakdown: units, band rate, and effective cost. Pro-rata adjustments are correct for mid-cycle plan changes (example scenarios attached).

Billing reconciliation: billing records and raw usage telemetry match within 0.5% for synthetic test accounts and within 2% for production day-1 in-scope customers after normalization (timezones, ingestion lag).
API contract: clients can query /v1/accounts/{id}/quota to retrieve current soft-cap, hard-cap, current band, and next-threshold; response schema stable for GA.
